reviewer_role: foundations/manuscript assistant role; internal review, not external peer review
method: Each final rendered PNG individually displayed with view_image and visually inspected for figures, tables, citation layout, clipping, overlap and readability.
scope: Pages 9–17 only; root separately reviews pages 1–8. This review does not certify scientific outcomes or external publication.

pages.notes: Causal diagram connectors now occupy free gaps; no text crossings. Results text legible and unclipped.
Both improvement charts and seven-arm table are legible. Float-page whitespace is acceptable; no clipped labels.
Forest-plot legend lies outside the data region. Intervals and labels are separate. Warm/fresh table is readable.
Equation, complete-cost table and recurrence accounting fit with legible typography and no clipping.
Resource-flow diagram has separated rows, decision note and caption. Unestablished usable capacity and reservation limits are explicit; no overlaps.
Browser limitations, conclusions and citations are readable and within margins.
Reproduction map and first claims-table segment fit; table rows are readable and not clipped.
Continued claims table and disclosures fit. Bibliography acronym and Omega case are preserved; URLs wrap within margins.
Remaining references retain title case and readable links with no clipping.
